descriptions.text: A small still-life painting in a style blending Studio Ghibli background art with Claude Monet's impressionism: a single raw red prawn, a deep scarlet shell with long fine antennae and a curled tail. Soft luminous brushstrokes, gentle colour, painterly edges, the subject centered and filling about three quarters of the frame with even margin on every side, on a plain pure white background, nothing else in frame, no text, only a soft ground-contact shadow.
